## Checklist

- [ ] The issue was agreed on before this PR (not needed for a small fix)
- [ ] `mise run check` passes locally (vet + lint + tests + govulncheck)
- [ ] Added or updated tests for the change
- [ ] Ran it with `mise run dev` on my own account (what I checked is below)
- [ ] Updated the English docs where behaviour changed (one sentence per line)
- [ ] Added a line to `CHANGELOG.md` under `[Unreleased]`, ending with `(#issue)`, if the change is user-facing
- [ ] The PR title follows the commit convention (`type: #issue Description`), since it becomes the squash commit
- [ ] If an AI assistant wrote most of the code, I say so below
